import hashlib,json,math
from pathlib import Path
root=Path("test-results/pr33824_expanded_all13_predictors_20260928_1933/models/llama-2-7b")
def load(path):
    return [json.loads(line) for line in path.read_text().splitlines() if line.strip()]
def digest(item):
    return hashlib.sha256(json.dumps(item["input_ids"],separators=(",",":")).encode()).hexdigest()
training=[item for path in (root/"calibration/real").glob("repeat-*/cases/*/TP0.raw_request.jsonl") for item in load(path)]
assert len(training)==800
train_ids={item["rid"] for item in training}; train_prompts={digest(item) for item in training}
previous_ids={item["rid"] for repeat in (1,2,3) for path in (root/f"holdout/real/repeat-{repeat}/cases").glob("*/TP0.raw_request.jsonl") for item in load(path)}
assert len(previous_ids)==768
group=root/"holdout/real/repeat-4"
assert (group/"BASELINE_COLLECTION_COMPLETE").read_text().strip()=="complete"
assert (group/"package_versions.txt").read_bytes()==(root/"calibration/real/repeat-1/package_versions.txt").read_bytes()
meta=dict(line.split("=",1) for line in (group/"run_metadata.txt").read_text().splitlines() if "=" in line)
assert int(meta["seed"])==202609383
cases={}; new_ids=set(); prompt_overlap=0
for path in sorted((group/"cases").glob("*/TP0.raw_request.jsonl")):
    case=path.parent
    assert (case/"status.txt").read_text().strip()=="ok"
    manifest=json.loads((case/"TP0.manifest.json").read_text())
    raw=load(path); trace=load(case/"autobench_trace.jsonl"); batches=load(case/"TP0.schedule_batch.jsonl")
    benchmark=load(case/"benchmark.jsonl")[-1]
    assert len(raw)==manifest["request_count"]==len(trace)==benchmark["completed"]
    assert len(batches)==manifest["schedule_batch_count"]
    assert all(math.isfinite(item["iter_latency"]) and 0<item["iter_latency"]<=30 for item in batches)
    copies={item["metadata"]["source_rid"]:item for item in trace}
    assert len(copies)==len(raw)
    for item in raw:
        assert item["rid"] not in train_ids|previous_ids|new_ids
        copied=copies[item["rid"]]
        assert len(item["input_ids"])==item["input_length"]==copied["prompt_len"]
        assert item["input_ids"]==copied["prompt"] and item["output_length"]==copied["output_len"]
        prompt_overlap+=int(digest(item) in train_prompts)
        new_ids.add(item["rid"])
    cases[case.name]={"requests":len(raw),"timing_rows":len(batches)}
assert len(cases)==5 and len(new_ids)==256 and prompt_overlap==0
print(json.dumps({"repeat":4,"seed":202609383,"cases":cases,"requests":len(new_ids),"timing_rows":sum(item["timing_rows"] for item in cases.values()),"training_prompt_overlap":prompt_overlap,"reused_request_ids":0,"actual_replay_payloads_verified":len(new_ids),"cumulative_independent_requests":len(previous_ids|new_ids)},sort_keys=True))
print("PASS: completed group 4 integrity; no model fitting/scoring or extra GPU workload.")
